run_train_gym_env: run the SampleFactory RL training script for a Gym environment like CartPole-v1 using APPO algorithm
run_custom_parse_args: run custom_parse_args to parse SampleFactory CLI arguments and return a configuration object for training
run_make_gym_env_func: run make_gym_env_func to create a Gym environment from a prefixed name like gym_CartPole-v1
run_register_custom_components: run register_custom_components to register Gym environment wrappers with the SampleFactory global environment registry
run_main: run main to register custom components, parse arguments, and execute the SampleFactory RL training algorithm
